name: Nox Ground Unit
title: Nox Ground Unit
note: Box W frame (X across, Y along the axle toward the front, Z up; the swap arm hub at the origin, the drone seat at (0, 167.1, 220.3)). In: the landing funnel v5 (13 Nov: the frame in two halves on four cross arms under the rain lid, each end wall on two lead-screw gearmotors; the halves and the arm are engine parts, shown as their drawn faces and room until their runs), latch v7 for both packs at the seat, the Scout v4 and the Overseer seated as they stand today, the swap arm from systems/swap_arm.assembly.json, the stand v2 (mast, two base halves, two rails: engine parts, shown as their drawn faces and room until their runs; four TPU feet), the v2 enclosure sheets to W Z 145 and the PSU as boxes, the Scout's rain dome and the rain lid. Out: the electronics. Compatibility between the streams: tools/box_check.py, its result under the viewer.
